info.title: The Facility: Null horror game build

messages.text:
"Create a high-end, photorealistic survival horror game titled \"The Facility: Null\". 
Take all the time required to generate, build, script, and polish every visual asset, UI element, voice line, and mechanic to absolute perfection, regardless of how long it takes.

0. CREATOR CREDIT @COMMENT_BODY@ TITLE SCREEN:
- Display the game title prominently on the main menu as: \"The Facility: Null\"
- Directly below the title, include the credit line: \"Created by °-° KING LOOK.S\" / \"Idee @COMMENT_BODY@ Konzept von °-° KING LOOK.S\" in a sleek, glowing metallic font.

1. LANGUAGE @COMMENT_BODY@ AUDIO SETTINGS:
- Language Options: The game settings, UI text, inventory, subtitles, and menus must be fully localized with a language switcher between German and English. 
- Menus @COMMENT_BODY@ Settings: Displayed in German by default (e.g., \"Einstellungen\", \"Grafik\", \"Multiplayer\", \"Steuerung\").
- Voice Acting @COMMENT_BODY@ Audio: All in-game dialogue, audio logs, radio calls, and character voices must remain in full, crystal-clear, professional English with precise 3D binaural spatial audio.

2. GRAPHICS @COMMENT_BODY@ VISUAL QUALITY:
- Photorealistic visual quality powered by high-resolution textures, volumetric atmospheric fog, ray-traced dynamic lighting, and realistic shadow effects.
- No global daytime lighting: the environment is dark, lit only by player flashlights, flickering emergency lights, and red alarm beacons.
- Extremely detailed indoor environments: abandoned underground medical complex, peeling wallpaper, cracked floor tiles, bloodstains, floating dust particles, and broken glass.

3. INTRO, GAME START @COMMENT_BODY@ STORY LORE:
- Game Intro: Starts with a cinematic cutscene. The player wakes up in a dark, locked security office. On a wooden desk sits a flickering lamp, a cassette recorder, and a blood-stained journal explaining the lore—an illegal genetic containment breach of a sound-sensitive host creature.
- Game Start: Players gather their starting items (a dying flashlight and a walkie-talkie) and must unlock the main security door to enter the facility.

4. OBJECTIVE @COMMENT_BODY@ GAME COMPLETION (WIN/LOSE CONDITIONS):
- Primary Objective: Navigate through 3 distinct sectors (Medical, Labs, Reactor) to collect 3 encrypted keycards, restore the main power generator, and activate the surface elevator.
- How the Game Ends (Victory): All surviving players must reach the surface elevator, call it down, defend the position for 60 seconds against the creature, and board the elevator to escape.
- Defeat Condition: If all players die or if the facility triggers its auto-detonation sequence before escaping, the game is lost.

5. SINGLEPLAYER MODE:
- Immersive, atmospheric solo experience with zero HUD on screen. 
- Health, stamina, and fear are displayed through in-game cues (heavy breathing, visible pulse, blurriness, blood splatters on screen).

6. MULTIPLAYER HUB @COMMENT_BODY@ MATCHMAKING:
Create a full-featured multiplayer system with three distinct options:
- A) Custom Private Lobby (Code System): The host creates a private lobby that generates a unique 4-character room code. Friends can enter this code in the menu to join the private session immediately.
- B) Quick Play (Public Matchmaking): One-click matchmaking that instantly pairs the player with random online players worldwide into an active 2-4 player lobby.
- C) Offline / Bot Match: Option to play multiplayer maps offline or fill empty slots with intelligent, cooperative AI bot teammates.

7. GAMEPLAY MECHANICS:
- 2 to 4 player co-op with proximity voice chat (creatures can hear players talking if they speak too loudly).
- Teamwork mechanics: sharing flashlight batteries, completing two-person puzzle interactions, and carrying/reviving downed teammates.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a playable survival-horror game titled “The Facility: Null” in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Title screen credit: “Created by °-° KING LOOK.S”; German by default with English/German localization; English voice logs.
- Dark, atmospheric abandoned medical facility with flashlight, flickering lights, fog, and horror cues.
- Campaign across Medical, Labs, and Reactor: collect three keycards, restore generator, call surface elevator, survive a 60-second defense, then escape.
- Include solo and co-op/bot options, lobby/code flows, and teamwork mechanics.
- User requested screenshots for checks, saved as small JPEGs at viewport width ≤1280px.

## Decisions
- Repository was an empty starter, so the assistant chose a self-contained browser game.
- Lobby and matchmaking flows are local simulations; actual online play requires a multiplayer backend.
- Current implementation uses a custom Canvas raycaster instead of external game libraries.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation; currently incomplete and needs immediate continuation.
